learning_outcomes.text: Furnish the basic notions of Mathematical Analysis necessary for physical and engineering applications.

syllabus_topics: One variable real functions: limits of real functions
differential calculus for real functions of a real variable
Integrals of real functions of a real variable
Real functions of more real variables Differential calculus for real functions of more real variables
teaching_methods: Lectures related to the theoretical topics of the course
Lectures on the exercises and on the solution of practical problems

assessment_methods.method: Optional oral test concerning theoretical topics
Midterm examinations (two, replacing the comprehensive written test)

assessment_rules: The exam consists of a written exam and an optional oral test. Two midterm examinations can replace the comprehensive written test. The evaluation considers expository clarity, understanding of topics, and mastery of scientific language. The final grade, out of thirty, is based on the achievement of requirements from the written and/or oral exam.
